strategies.description: Keep inputs light. Accept more uncovered demand to limit surplus.

policy_parameters.description: Keep inputs light. Accept more uncovered demand to limit surplus.

objective_terms.unit: SGD-equivalent policy utility; coefficients are declared preferences, not forecast costs

Scenario weights are validated, normalized and consumed by the weighted objective. No random scenario sampling is performed.

claims.statement: All strategies are marked feasible with no declared hard-constraint violations, yet booked delivery falls well short of booked requested volume across the board; later-week orders show no delivered quantity. Frozen shortfall and fill-rate values remain unverified context until the chair confirms policy:automatic_selection.

Frozen synthetic plan metrics for all strategies are declared feasible with no hard-constraint violations, and fill rates remain partial, so coverage is incomplete rather than guaranteed. Public weather is context only and gives sheltered crops no direct rainfall yield multiplier.

Booked-price forecasts are frozen for all listed crops, and each strategy's residual requested volume is nonzero, so no strategy demonstrates full demand coverage. No community feed is connected, so buyer and grower reactions cannot be treated as demand.

All three frozen strategies carry no declared hard-constraint violation, yet each fill rate stays below full demand coverage; feasible therefore means only that no declared resource, timing or inventory rule was breached.

claims.statement: Frozen calculations show all strategies free of declared hard violations, yet each leaves booked residual demand undelivered; harvest dates cluster on the same calibration boundaries so timing feasibility rests on declaration, not measured logistics.

Across the declared strategies, the frozen cost, labour, revenue and margin figures rise together, and each strategy reports no hard-constraint violation, so all are feasible on declared constraints while demand coverage remains unverified.

Under policy:automatic_selection, feasible strategies lacking declared allocation violations are eligible, with Balanced preferred ahead of higher fill rate, margin and stable identifier. Frozen synthetic metrics show each strategy free of declared hard violations while coverage stays partial, so selection proceeds by declared policy rather than any ranking I invent.
